README.note: All scores are leave-one-year-out: train on 8 of 2012-2020, predict the 9th (never seen).
Main metric: monthly national WAPE = sum|pred - actual| / sum(actual), day+night summed.
Exam years fixed in advance: 2012 (January excluded, S-NPP starts 20 Jan 2012), 2019, 2020.
Chosen method: lowest exam-year WAPE, tie-break interannual_ratio closest to 1 -> Fusion G1.
Simulation: point-level synthetic VIIRS, 5 runs per year; control = same number of real VIIRS points
drawn from the same month of training years.
